messages:
Ming: heads-up — seeing a detok/regression for Korean+Hanja after int8 bringup on zephyr-v2. sample failing on en->ko translation and multiword hanja boundaries. repro attached.

Sara: can you paste an example? which quant config? PTQ or QAT? :eyes:

Ming: PTQ w/ per-channel dynamic range. quantized with our qconfig 'int8-dyn-pc-v3'. repro below.

Ming: ```
Input: Translate to Korean: 'Professor 金氏는 서울에 산다.'
Zephyr fp16 decode: "김 교수는 서울에 산다."
Zephyr int8 decode: "김 교수 는 서울 에 산다 ."  <-- extra spaces introduced between Hanja and particles
Diff tokens (fp16): [김,  , 교수, 는,  , 서울, 에,  , 산다, .]
Diff tokens (int8): [김,  , 교수,  , 는,  , 서울,  , 에,  , 산다,  , .]
```

Sara: hmm looks like detok/merge joiner heuristic changed and is inserting separators. did the tokenizer build bump to tok-v1.5 recently?

Jun: checked the build: tok-v1.5 landed in the runtime image yesterday (rollout job #4521). tok-v1.5 changed the joiner-unicode heuristic to be more conservative (this was intended for CJK-Latin spacing).

Oliver: BLEU on ko-zh dev set dropped ~3.2 for the int8 variant, and token-shift-rate alarmed in nightly. Could also be normalization (NFKC) order changed during detok.

Ming: command I used to repro locally:
```bash
python -m regen.evaluate --model zephyr-v2:int8 --tokenizer tok-v1.5 --detok detok-v1.5 --input samples/ko-hanja.txt
```

CI-bot: nightly eval pipeline for zephyr-v2:int8 finished — regression flagged:
- ko-hanja-suite BLEU: -3.18
- token-shift-rate: 0.047 (threshold 0.02)
See: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/runs/4521

Sara: can we reproduce with tok-v1.4 + detok-v1.4? Jun, can you try reverting joiner behavior in a local token build?

Jun: quick experiment: rebuilt tokenizer with joiner revert patch (tok-v1.5-joiner-revert). Local eval shows int8 outputs now match fp16 for 94% of failing samples. spacing around mixed Hanja-Korean now preserved.

Ming: i've added a minimal failing case to the eval harness and a tentative fix that re-applies the joiner rule for Han-family characters. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/zephyr/pull/12345 — cc @Oliver @Jun

Oliver: looked at the PR, main logic is fine. one nit on comment, but LGTM. if CI is green we should canary the tokenizer + int8 model together.

CI-bot: PR build passed; staging canary deploy scheduled at 2026-03-22T22:30:00Z (job 4589).

Jun: after canary results (ran quick smoke), int8 + tok-v1.5-joiner-revert matches fp16 on 98% of sliding-window checks. residual issues only on concatenated proper nouns (compound Hanja sequences) — low impact.

Sara: great — please add the new cases to "locale/ko-hanja" suite and mark the threshold tighter for token-shift-rate. also add a short note in release notes about tokenizer behavior. :thumbsup:

Ming: will do, pushing tests and changelog now. thanks all.
